name: The Booker Prize
description: The leading literary award in the English-speaking world, awarded annually for the best sustained work of fiction written in English and published in the UK or Ireland.

name: The Pulitzer Prize for Fiction
description: Awarded for distinguished fiction by an American author, preferably dealing with American life.

name: National Book Award for Fiction
description: Celebrates the best literature published in the United States, judged by independent panels of accomplished writers.

name: Women's Prize for Fiction
description: One of the most prestigious literary prizes in the world, awarded annually to a woman of any nationality for a full-length novel in English.

name: International Booker Prize
description: Awarded annually for a single book translated into English and published in the UK or Ireland, splitting the prize equally between author and translator.

name: International Dublin Literary Award
description: One of the world's richest literary prizes for a single work of fiction, with nominations submitted by public libraries worldwide.

name: The Goldsmiths Prize
description: Rewards fiction that breaks the mould or extends the possibilities of the novel form.

name: Hugo Award for Best Novel
description: The premier award for science fiction and fantasy literature, voted on by members of the World Science Fiction Convention.

name: Nebula Award for Best Novel
sponsor: Science Fiction and Fantasy Writers Association (SFWA)
description: Awarded annually by SFWA to recognize the best speculative fiction published in the United States.

name: National Book Critics Circle Award for Fiction
description: Selected by an elected board of nearly thirty practicing book reviewers and critics across America.
